brief.title: The Sunken Crypt
brief.theme: a flooded crypt beneath a ruined chapel
brief.style_notes: cold water, old stone, candle stubs
decisions: the reliquary is behind a locked gate

stair.name: The Flooded Stair
stair.desc: Black water laps at your shins. The steps climb out of it to the north.

ossuary.name: The Ossuary
ossuary.desc: Skulls line the niches in neat rows. Their empty sockets follow you.

reliquary.name: The Drowned Reliquary
reliquary.desc: A silver casket rests on a drowned altar. Candle stubs float around it.

iron_key.name: a rusted iron key
iron_key.desc: Flakes of rust come away on your fingers.

loot.concept: a charm of knotted finger bones

skeleton.name: a skeletal sentry
skeleton.desc: Bones held together by rusted wire creak as it turns its head.

candle_stub.name: a candle stub
candle_stub.desc: Black wax, bitten down to the wick.

bone_charm.name: a bone charm
bone_charm.desc: Finger bones knotted on a cord click against each other.
